operation: Frozen-model inference implementation equivalence, not training or physical simulation
sampling: 24 ticks0..23; time series with interpolation off; each tick one published-average query view

decoder.nonselection: margin<0.15 or exact equal pair scores
decoder.forced_tie: smallest candidate index; accepted pairs ascending

tolerance_reason: Double matrix arithmetic, tanh and exp may differ at last floating-point bits between legacy MATLAB and generated MATLAB Function simulation. Absolute+relative1e-10 applies only to scores/logits/normalization/margin; categorical decisions and all counts must be exact. Threshold is never retuned to pass.
truth_is_separate: True labels enter only post-simulation outcomes and metric reporting, never the SLX predictor.
reference: Legacy r04nn_predict/r04nn_logits/r04nn_pair_softmax + original final-stage saved decision CSV. Numeric core is embedded into MATLAB Function block by builder; real generated SLX and actual numeric trace required later.

model_MAT.pin_origin: Accepted v23 public manifest; no MAT read/hash in authoring.

saved_decision_CSV.pin_origin: Accepted v23 public manifest; only header+first row read during authoring.

future_IO_scope: One semantic MAT load; one source readtable; one archived-decision readtable; code/protocol small text;30 simulator calls in one newly owned MATLAB process. No model-weight byte rehash inside driver; prior pins are reported as prior evidence, not fresh checks.
actual_runtime_budget: Root-owned scoped MATLAB launch, proposed300s total wall budget. No new watchdog architecture, global process closure or automatic repeat. On concrete fault retain receipt and repair narrowly.
delivered_SLX_example: First declared checkpoint linear/sequential_no_replay/seed101/stage3; not selected for performance. Full30-checkpoint result separate.
